title: Hardening checklist: redaction never alters executed or stored-for-execution values
body: Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md `secrets` class adds: a value that will be executed or used as a path is never redacted in place; a credential-like value is refused (exit 64/65) instead. Evidence: PR #191 review records e962b36f…/records/2.json BLOCKING (cli.ts stored checks.map(redact), driver ran an altered command). Proof: krn brief check fixture brief lacking the clause still passes (checklist text only) — test/rules/hardening-checklist.test.ts asserts the clause.
